qualifier: with mitochondrial depolarization in apoptosis
name: Nucleoside-nucleobase transport and mitochondrial apoptotic depolarization
rationale: Most members are plasma-membrane purine/pyrimidine nucleoside and nucleobase transport, and unlike the confusables (nucleotide interconversion, ADP/ATP mitochondrial carriers, antiviral drug ADME) the theme adds mitochondrial depolarization and intrinsic apoptosis regulation.

qualifier: noncanonical caspase-4/5 and NLRC4 (IPAF), bacterial sensing
name: Noncanonical caspase-4/5 and NLRC4 inflammasomes
rationale: All members concern CASP4/CASP5 and IPAF/NLRC4 inflammasome activation against enterobacteria driving pyroptosis, whereas confusables centre on AIM2, NLRP1/NLRP3 and IL-1/IL-18 processing.

qualifier: positive drive of G1/S and G2/M transitions
name: E2F-activated transcription driving cell cycle progression
rationale: Members are E2F target/network gene sets and positive regulators of G1/S and G2/M transitions, distinct from confusables on DNA replication licensing, RB1/DREAM repression of E2F, and the G2/M checkpoint.

qualifier: by incretins (GLP-1, GIP), free fatty acid receptors and acetylcholine
name: Incretin, fatty acid and acetylcholine regulation of insulin secretion
rationale: All members concern glucose-stimulated insulin secretion by beta cells, specifically via GLP-1/GIP, FFAR1 and acetylcholine, whereas confusables emphasize adrenergic inhibition, glucagon signaling, or KATP channels.

qualifier: destruction complex turnover and TCF target regulation
name: Canonical Wnt/beta-catenin signaling and TCF target regulation
rationale: Members span canonical Wnt receptor activation, AXIN/DVL turnover and TCF/LEF:CTNNB1 transcription, distinguishing it from confusables on Notch signaling, Wnt ligand secretion, and non-canonical Ca2+ Wnt pathways.

qualifier: trabeculation, endocardium and coronary vasculogenesis
name: Ventricular trabeculation, endocardium and coronary vessel development
rationale: Members concern growth of the embryonic ventricular wall (trabecular myocardium, ventricular cardiomyocytes) together with endocardial and coronary vascular cell differentiation, unlike confusables centred on septa, valves, cushions, atria or adult cardiomyocyte proliferation and regeneration.

core: Control of neuronal excitability and inhibitory transmission
qualifier: glycinergic synapse
name: Glycinergic inhibition and neuronal excitability control
rationale: Members share neural control of excitability (glycinergic transmission and hyperekplexia, dampening of nerve impulses and calcium channels, action potential regulation, MECP2-GABA genes, neuronal mRNA translation repressors), distinguishing it from confusables dominated by MECP2 disease variants or locomotor and social behaviors.

core: Oxidative eicosanoid and fatty acid metabolism
qualifier: P450 omega-hydroxylase and epoxygenase plus 12-lipoxygenase hepoxilin branches
name: P450 omega-hydroxylase, epoxygenase and 12-lipoxygenase eicosanoid metabolism
rationale: Members cover cytochrome P450 omega-hydroxylation (HETEs, LTB4 catabolism, CYP4F22), epoxygenation (EETs) and 12-LOX hepoxilin synthesis of arachidonic and linoleic acids, distinct from confusables on lipoxins, 5/15-LOX products and cysteinyl leukotriene synthesis.

qualifier: with phosphocreatine shuttle, mitochondrial ADP/ATP exchange and oxygen transport
name: Glycolysis with phosphocreatine shuttle and oxygen transport
rationale: Members combine glycolysis with cellular energy buffering (creatine/phosphocreatine, mitochondrial ADP/ATP transport) and oxygen transport, which the confusables (gluconeogenesis, glycogen, fermentation, fructose-2,6-bisphosphate) lack.

core: Hexose phosphate and central carbohydrate metabolism
qualifier: fructose and glycerol utilization with gluconeogenesis and glycogenolysis
name: Glucose and fructose phosphate metabolism with gluconeogenesis and glycerol
rationale: Members span glucose phosphorylation, G6P transport/hydrolysis, glycogen breakdown, gluconeogenesis from alanine/oxaloacetate, and fructose and glycerol catabolism, distinct from confusables on glycogen synthesis disorders, galactose or pentose phosphate metabolism.

qualifier: with snRNA gene transcription and cap hypermethylation
name: Spliceosomal mRNA splicing and snRNA gene transcription
rationale: Members cover spliceosome assembly, splice-site recognition and splicing regulation together with Pol II/Pol III snRNA transcription and snRNA cap hypermethylation, unlike confusables on nuclear RNA decay, histone mRNA 3' processing, snRNP export, or Pol I/III rRNA and tRNA transcription.

core: Striated muscle sarcomere assembly and contraction
qualifier: SRF transcriptional targets
name: SRF-targeted sarcomere assembly and striated muscle contraction
rationale: All members concern sarcomeric thin/thick filament organization and striated muscle contraction, and the SRF-target actin/contraction modules distinguish it from confusables on dystrophin complex, neuromuscular junction, cardiomyocyte junctions and myogenesis.

core: MHC class I and II antigen processing and presentation
qualifier: proteasomal and endosomal processing, cross-presentation and HIV Nef/Vpu evasion
name: Proteasomal and endosomal antigen processing for MHC presentation
rationale: Members cover proteasome assembly and degradation, peptide loading of MHC class I/II/Ib, cross-presentation and viral downregulation of MHC and co-receptors, distinguishing it from confusables on PD-L1 regulation, immune cell surface signatures and NKT cell activation.

qualifier: NGF production, TRKA downstream cascades and p75NTR complexes
name: NGF production and TRKA/p75NTR downstream signaling
rationale: Members span NGF processing and binding, TRKA-driven ERK5/p38/PI3K/CREB signaling and p75NTR signalling complexes, unlike confusables on BDNF/NT-3 via NTRK2/NTRK3 or p75NTR-mediated death and proteolysis.

qualifier: mammary and prostate gland, genital tract and gonad sex differentiation
name: Mammary, prostate, genital tract and gonad development
rationale: Members cover mammary and prostate gland branching and epithelial lineages, Mullerian-derived and external genitalia, and gonadal sex determination, distinguishing it from confusables on lung/salivary branching, germ cell and Sertoli biology, or pancreatic lineages.

core: Negative feedback inactivation of ERK MAPK
qualifier: by dual-specificity (tyrosine/threonine) dephosphorylation
name: Dual-specificity phosphatase inactivation of ERK MAPK
rationale: All members concern dephosphorylation of phospho-tyrosine/threonine on ERK and feedback suppression of MAPK signalling, whereas confusables cover upstream RAS/RAF/MAP2K activation, RSK, or IL-6-driven ERK activation.

qualifier: Tat-dependent and Tat-independent pausing and recovery
name: HIV-1 transcription elongation, pausing and Tat interactions
rationale: Every member is an HIV-1 Pol II elongation step (early elongation complex, abortive elongation, arrest and recovery, with or without Tat), distinguishing it from confusables on generic Pol II initiation, promoter escape and elongation regulation.

qualifier: formyl peptide receptors and CXCL1/2, CCL2/3/5 chemokine induction
name: Formyl peptide receptor and chemokine-driven neutrophil and macrophage recruitment
rationale: Members concern recruitment of neutrophils, granulocytes and macrophages via formyl peptide receptors and induction of CXC/CC chemokines, unlike confusables on neutrophil degranulation, negative regulation of migration, extravasation, or dendritic cell cytokines.

core: Calcium handling in striated muscle contraction
qualifier: ryanodine receptor SR calcium release and sodium-calcium exchange, contraction dampening
name: Ryanodine receptor Ca2+ release and Na+/Ca2+ exchange in striated muscle
rationale: Members concern regulation of sarcoplasmic reticulum calcium release via ryanodine receptors and cytosolic calcium clearance by Na+/Ca2+ exchangers controlling cardiac/skeletal contraction and relaxation, unlike confusables on SERCA/ATPase uptake and positive inotropic or chronotropic regulation.

qualifier: endocardial cushion EMT, neural crest outflow tract and great arteries
name: Cardiac cushion valves, septa, outflow tract and great arteries
rationale: Members cover endocardial cushion EMT forming valves and septa plus neural crest-dependent outflow tract septation and aortic, pulmonary, pharyngeal arch and coronary artery morphogenesis, distinguishing it from confusables on heart tube, secondary heart field, ventricular trabeculation and myocardium.

core: Viral genome establishment in the host nucleus
qualifier: retroviral DNA integration and herpesviral latency with host restriction
name: Viral DNA integration, latency and host restriction
rationale: Members concern nuclear stages of DNA virus and retrovirus persistence (PIC import, integration, 2-LTR/autointegration circles, HCMV events, latency) and host restriction of them (APOBEC3G, transcriptional suppression, LRRFIP1 IFN), distinct from confusables on HIV entry and reverse transcription or endogenous retroelement silencing.

qualifier: linkage-specific (K6/K11/K27/K29/K48/K63) chains and DUB families
name: Linkage-specific ubiquitin chain synthesis and deubiquitinase editing
rationale: All members concern building or trimming specific polyubiquitin linkages by E1/E2 enzymes and USP, OTU and metalloprotease DUBs, distinguishing it from confusables on E3 ligase targeting, neddylation and proteasome, or NF-kB/TNFR1 ubiquitin signaling.

qualifier: rod photoreceptor, bipolar and amacrine cells with layer formation
name: Retinal rod, bipolar and amacrine neuron development and lamination
rationale: Members concern differentiation of retinal neuron classes (rods, bipolar, amacrine) and retinal layer formation, unlike confusables on photoreceptor outer segment maintenance and cones, gross eye morphogenesis, or DSCAM/sidekick adhesion.

qualifier: hair follicle, nail, sebaceous and mammary gland placodes
name: Hair follicle, nail, sebaceous and mammary ectodermal appendage development
rationale: Members cover placode-derived ectodermal appendages (hair follicle formation and cycling, nail, sebaceous and mammary gland) and epidermal morphogenesis, distinguishing it from confusables on interfollicular keratinocyte differentiation and cornification, melanocytes, or tooth development.

qualifier: TLR7/9-TRAF6-IRF7 signaling in dendritic cells
name: TLR7/9-IRF7 type I interferon production in dendritic cells
rationale: Members concern TLR9/TLR7-driven, TRAF6-IRF7 and DEx/H-helicase induction of interferon-alpha/beta in activated dendritic cells, whereas confusables centre on RIG-I/MDA5-IRF3, cGAS-STING or broader antiviral responses.
